card.name: Pathologic after path- in labels
card.fires_on: The ending "ologic" or "ological" right after "path", or the word "pathological" after "active", in drug-label warnings.

modes.label: Path + ologic
modes.description: The ending of "pathologic/pathological" after the start "Path" in label text.
modes.example: There are rare reports of path<<ologic>> skin changes in patients with normal renal function

modes.label: Active pathological bleeding
modes.description: The whole word "pathological" after "active" in contraindication lists.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it suppresses heart-related words and promotes assorted unrelated tokens such as roma and indent.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "pathologic" or "pathological" in label warnings, such as pathological gambling or pathological bleeding.
